verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਪਾਰੋ ਖਾਤ ਗਾਤਿ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਹੋਤ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਰੋ ਖਾਤ ਗਾਤ ਹੋਤ ਉਪਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: soiee paaro khaat gaat bibidh bikaar hot soiee paaro khaat gaat hot upachaar hai ||

en.bdb: Just as consuming raw mercury produces several ailments in the body but when treated with certain chemicals and purified, can cure many diseases.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਪਾਰੋ ਪਰਸਤ ਕੰਚਨਹਿ ਸੋਖ ਲੇਤ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਰੋ ਪਰਸ ਤਾਂਬੋ ਕਨਿਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: soiee paaro parasat ka(n)chaneh sokh let soiee paaro paras taa(n)bo kanik dhaar hai ||

en.bdb: Just as gold placed in raw mercury reacts to lose its identity but when the same chemically reacted mercury mixes with copper becomes gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਪਾਰੋ ਅਗਹੁ ਨ ਹਾਥਨ ਕੈ ਗਹਿਓ ਜਾਇ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਰੋ ਗੁਟਕਾ ਹੁਇ ਸਿਧ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: soiee paaro agahu na haathan kai gahio jai soiee paaro guTakaa hui sidh namasakaar hai ||

en.bdb: The mercury that is so unstable and restless that it cannot be held with hands but the same becomes respectable for yogis and sidhs when converted chemically into small tablets.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਜੈਸੀਐ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤੈਸੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਦਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਅਧਿਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੪੬੯॥
verses.translit_en: maanas janam pai jaiseeaai sa(n)gat milai taisee paavai padhavee prataap adhikaar hai ||469||

en.bdb: Similarly, based on the company he keeps during his life, he attains a befitting status in the world. If he remains among devotees of the True Guru, he achieves salvation; if he worships other gods, then the angels of death punsih him. (469)
